const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboLab eai-standard/2.2 pick-and-place controller for the three small bottles.
+
+The object and bin coordinates below were measured by back-projecting visible
+cap/rim pixels with the camera calibration returned by the service.  This file
+is the episode control record; it is not safe to rerun from the beginning.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import EpisodeOver, Robot
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output/trajectory")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+q_down = [0.0, -2**-0.5, 2**-0.5, 0.0]
+calls = 0
+
+
+def snap(label: str):
+    obs = r.get_obs(depth=True, video="none")
+    folder = OUT / f"{calls:02d}-{label}"
+    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, rgb in obs.last.items():
+        from PIL import Image
+        Image.fromarray(rgb).save(folder / f"{cam}.jpg", quality=90)
+    (folder / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+    for cam, d in obs.last_depth.items():
+        np.save(folder / f"{cam}_depth.npy", d)
+    return obs
+
+
+def pose(x: float, y: float, z: float, grip: float, label: str):
+    global calls
+    calls += 1
+    row = np.array([[x, y, z, *q_down, grip]], dtype=np.float32)
+    try:
+        res = r.submit("ee_pose", row, video="none", note=label)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        # Keep the service's same-episode recovery behavior explicit in the record.
+        print(f"submit error at {label}: {exc}; waiting for same-episode service", flush=True)
+        status = r.wait_ready()
+        print("resumed status", status, flush=True)
+        if status.get("done"):
+            return None
+        res = r.submit("ee_pose", row, video="none", note=label + " retry")
+    print(label, "done=", res.meta.get("done"), "plan=", res.meta.get("plan"),
+          "tcp=", np.round(res.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])[8:15], 4), flush=True)
+    if res.meta.get("done"):
+        return res
+    folder = OUT / f"{calls:02d}-{label}"
+    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (folder / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
+    for cam, rgb in res.last.items():
+        from PIL import Image
+        Image.fromarray(rgb).save(folder / f"{cam}.jpg", quality=90)
+    return res
+
+
+def watch(seconds: float, label: str):
+    global calls
+    calls += 1
+    obs = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    print(label, "done=", obs.meta.get("done"), "opening=", round(now[24], 4),
+          "gripcmd=", now[15], "tcp=", np.round(now[8:15], 4), flush=True)
+    folder = OUT / f"{calls:02d}-{label}"
+    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (folder / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+    for cam, rgb in obs.last.items():
+        from PIL import Image
+        Image.fromarray(rgb).save(folder / f"{cam}.jpg", quality=90)
+    return obs
+
+
+def execute():
+    # Centers of the three small bottle caps in env-local metres (x, y).
+    # Grasp at the lower body with the TCP 28 mm above the tabletop.
+    bottles = [
+        ("bottle_a", 0.483, 0.016),
+        ("bottle_b", 0.363, 0.150),
+        ("bottle_c", 0.290, 0.019),
+    ]
+    bin_x, bin_y = 0.410, -0.185
+    grasp_z = 0.028
+
+    print("starting status", r.status(), flush=True)
+    for name, x, y in bottles:
+        if r.status().get("done"):
+            break
+        # Approach above the cap, descend vertically with the fingers open,
+        # close and allow the gripper time to settle before lifting.
+        if pose(x, y, 0.200, 0.0, name + "_approach") is None:
+            break
+        if r.status().get("done"):
+            break
+        if pose(x, y, grasp_z, 0.0, name + "_descend") is None:
+            break
+        if r.status().get("done"):
+            break
+        if pose(x, y, grasp_z, 1.0, name + "_close") is None:
+            break
+        obs = watch(0.55, name + "_grasp_settle")
+        if obs.meta.get("done"):
+            break
+        now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+        opening = float(now[24])
+        print(name, "gripper opening after close", opening, flush=True)
+        # If the fingers reached their empty-stop, do not carry on as though
+        # the bottle were held; leave state and images in the episode record.
+        if opening < 0.006:
+            print("No bottle detected in gripper; stopping for inspection.", flush=True)
+            snap(name + "_miss_inspection")
+            break
+        if pose(x, y, 0.245, 1.0, name + "_lift") is None:
+            break
+        if r.status().get("done"):
+            break
+        # Carry high enough to clear the utility jugs, then release above the
+        # middle of the square pail's opening.
+        if pose(bin_x, bin_y, 0.305, 1.0, name + "_carry_to_pail") is None:
+            break
+        if r.status().get("done"):
+            break
+        if pose(bin_x, bin_y, 0.285, 0.0, name + "_release") is None:
+            break
+        obs = watch(0.65, name + "_release_settle")
+        if obs.meta.get("done"):
+            print("episode completed during release", flush=True)
+            break
+        snap(name + "_after_release")
+    print("final status", r.status(), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    execute()
*** End Patch";
